name: MERIDIAN: Open New Share
description: Signs on to MERIDIAN CORE, opens a new share for a member, and reports the confirmation number and new share id.

inputParams.name: username
inputParams.description: Operator ID used to sign on.

inputParams.name: password
inputParams.description: Operator password used to sign on.

inputParams.name: branch
inputParams.description: Branch to sign on at (e.g. MAIN-001).

inputParams.name: memberId
inputParams.description: The member to open the new share for.

inputParams.name: shareType
inputParams.description: Share type code to open: "S0001" (Regular Shares), "S0070" (Share Draft/Checking), "MMKT" (Money Market), or "CERT" (Certificate).

inputParams.name: deposit
inputParams.description: Initial deposit amount. Plain numeric value, no currency symbol. Certificates require a $500.00 minimum.

knownOutcomes.description: The requested share/deposit combination failed a real business rule (e.g. certificate minimum opening deposit of $500.00) -- a legitimate business outcome, not a system error.

knownOutcomes.name: permission_denied
knownOutcomes.description: The signed-on operator is not authorized for this function.

knownOutcomes.name: maintenance
knownOutcomes.description: The host reported a transient maintenance window; safe to retry the same step once -- this occurs before the irreversible /post step commits anything.

knownOutcomes.name: application_error
